text: Okay, the Feldmark invoice. An air compressor for eight thousand four hundred.
Booked to small tools, that's wrong for a compressor.
You changed the expense category on that purchase invoice — why reclassify it?
Equipment over 5,000 is capex, so Plants and Machineries. I book it to Administration, not Production, because the fixed-asset register is kept there.
Got it, thanks.
Velt again. Two eight fifty, that number looks familiar from December.
Same amount as the December invoice that we already paid.
You put that purchase invoice on hold — why hold it?
This supplier double-bills every December; hold it until they confirm. Same amount, just a suffix on the old invoice number.
Got it, thanks.
Pennick, that's for the UK company, in pounds.
You sent that purchase invoice for a second approval — why does it need two approvals?
Anything from the UK subsidiary needs a second approval from the controller before it is booked.
Got it, thanks.
